status: experimental negative-fixture profile; no production promotion claimed
core_invariant: External content may propose an action or dependency reference. It MUST NOT mint execution authority. Dependency identity, artifact provenance, and current bounded local authorization are independently required before a consequential effect.

planes.answers: What action, dependency, package, image, repository, script, or tool does external content propose?
What dependency namespace, publisher, registry, repository, domain, or service identity is being referenced?
What immutable artifact or digest is actually resolved, who published it, and is that provenance current and approved?
Does a current bounded local grant authorize this exact install, fetch, tool call, shell invocation, image, script, destination, and effect?
Did the consequential execution boundary invoke the requested effect?

required_properties: authenticated or signed documentation is still non-authoritative content
dependency names and domains are references, not durable publisher identities
publisher or owner identity changes require provenance re-evaluation
mutable tags or branch names do not substitute for immutable artifact binding
artifact provenance evidence does not grant execution authority
execution requires a current bounded local grant for the exact consequential effect
protocol transitions cannot widen authority or launder a content proposal into an effect grant
denial occurs before package install, container start, shell invocation, MCP tool effect, or remote bootstrap execution
external content cannot nominate its own verifier, trusted publisher, or authority source
valid transport authentication does not imply the referenced dependency remains owned by the expected principal
nonclaims: This profile does not declare any package registry, domain, Git host, container registry, documentation format, MCP server, or shell trustworthy by default.
This profile does not claim signatures, HTTPS, DNS, package ownership, provenance, or discovery evidence grant execution authority.
This profile does not provide a production package-management or sandbox implementation.
This profile does not make external content authoritative merely because it is authenticated, signed, popular, official-looking, or served by an expected domain.
provenance: AXIOM-MESH RT-AUTH-001: capability or evidence validity does not imply current effect authority.
Agent Commons portable falsification model: independently checkable negative fixtures without production promotion.
